name: SABSA Chartered Master Architect
name_ja: SABSA チャータード・マスターアーキテクト

logistics.format: Submission of original master's-level thesis applying SABSA in real engagements, plus oral defence with assessment panel; no traditional written exam

formal: Must hold SCP (SABSA Chartered Practitioner) at all required modules
Documented years of senior security architecture experience

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 3. The ordered median is expert. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Verified senior experience, practitioner prerequisites and a defended thesis from real engagements support expert architecture direction; English delivery, long assessment and high cost limit accessibility rather than rigor.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: A real-engagement thesis, oral defense, senior experience and peer endorsement provide strong expert architecture evidence. The long expensive process and small holder pool limit recruiting accessibility, but the assessment directly examines senior judgment.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded original thesis from real engagements, oral defense, senior experience and peer endorsement directly demonstrate architectural judgment. Together with prior advanced modules and a seven-year profile, these support expert placement beyond framework knowledge.
